newsitem.title: UK: BFI up two as Panamax demand remains solid.
newsitem.headline: BFI up two as Panamax demand remains solid.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up four to 1,371 points on Friday and brokers said further solid demand for Panamaxes especially in the Atlantic resulted in steady fixtures.

Esperis P 70,179 dwt has been fixed delivery Parangua/Vitoria range Aug 4/11 for trip Far East at $12,900 daily plus $290,000 bonus by Panocean suggesting a continuation of current conditions into next month. Captain John L 64,000 dwt has been fixed by Halla delivery Egypt mid July for three to five months redelivery Atlantic at $8,500 daily.
In the East Tradigrain booked Halla tonnage for 54,000 heavy grain NoPac to Taiwan early August at a steady $13.50.
Caper and Handy-size markets by contrast were quiet with brokers noting possible potential weakness for Capers in the short term.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was mostly unchanged and turnover was just two lots.
